units.source_text: 不知為何，比起對那個商人的憎惡，

en.t: For some reason, more than my hatred for that merchant,

units.source_text: 倒是堀木，他最初發現時，沒有在第一時間大聲咳嗽阻止，就那麼跑回樓頂來告訴我，

en.t: it was Horiki, who, when he first found out, did not immediately stop it with a loud cough, but simply ran back up to the roof to tell me,

units.source_text: 這種憎恨和憤怒會常常在我輾轉難眠時湧上心頭，讓我唏噓不已。

en.t: that hatred and anger would often surge up in me on sleepless nights and leave me groaning in anguish.

units.source_text: 不是原諒和不原諒的問題。

en.t: It was not a question of forgiving or not forgiving.

units.source_text: 良子是一個信賴人的天才。

en.t: Yoshiko was a genius at trusting people.
She was someone who did not know how to doubt others.
That was precisely what made it tragic.

units.source_text: 我問神靈，信賴也是罪過嗎？

en.t: I ask God: is trust a sin too?

units.source_text: 對我來說，比起良子的肉體遭到玷汙這件事，良子的信賴被玷汙，

en.t: For me, more than the fact that Yoshiko's body had been defiled, it was the defilement of Yoshiko's trust

units.source_text: 才是造成我日後無法活下去的苦惱根源。

en.t: that became the source of the anguish that later made it impossible for me to go on living.
